gaps.hands_not_separable: the packet requires man + TWO hands + book as one group, and per-role masks for all roles present. At 640x360 in this flat-colour source the two hands are not resolved as two distinct roles by either route; they appear inside the character/held-object group. Recorded as an unmet role-resolution dependency, not silently merged.
gaps.vision_unavailable: no semantic inspection of any frame was possible; all labels are structural or come from cross-referenced project records
gaps.between_anchor_frames_not_annotated: annotation exists at the declared anchor cadence only; frames between anchors are an explicit gap, not interpolated
gaps.uncovered_by_route_a: SAM 2.1 automatic masks leave flat background regions uncovered (per-anchor uncovered_pct recorded); route B colour regions cover those pixels at lower confidence - they are NOT silently treated as background
gaps.overlap_occlusion_class: PARTIAL - NOT DEMONSTRATED. The source is documented (locked profile) to contain occlusion (props in front of the torso, characters crossing/grouping), and W01_BOOK is a real prop-held-in-front-of-body scene. But this fixture did NOT measure an occlusion event: the annotated windows produced 0 occlusion events, and the containment test returns only SAM2 mask nesting (whole-object plus part masks), which occurs with no occlusion present. Z-order is therefore recorded as unresolved rather than guessed.
gaps.mask_count_is_not_role_count: MEASURED: SAM 2.1 automatic mask generation returns nested masks, so on this source mask_count (3..25 across anchors) is NOT the role count. Any downstream task comparing role counts to mask counts will be wrong; see relations_<tag>.json measured_nesting.
gaps.camera_motion_class_basis: camera_motion is asserted ONLY where every quadrant shifts together (quadrant_min_shift_mean > 1 px). On this film that is rare: only 318 of 39634 frames (0.80%) show >1 px global shift on non-held frames, so the class rests on a small number of windows and this scarcity is a property of the film, not of the fixture.
gaps.provisional_risk_loops_unreliable: The locked profile's provisional REF-R02/R04/R05 windows are marked 'to be snapped to canonical frame IDs'. Measured here: the R05 window (film 32314-32434) is 100.0% low-change and R02 (film 2916-3036) is 99.16% low-change - i.e. they land on static holds, not on the motion the profile intends to cover. They were therefore NOT used as benchmark windows.
gaps.low_change_metric_definition: 'held_pct' in this fixture means mad <= 0.5 on a 320x180 grayscale difference, i.e. near-static, NOT bit-identical. Bit-identical repeat frames are reported separately as exact_repeat_frames_measured.
